entries.en: We heard about the missing dog on TV during breakfast.
entries.zh: 我们吃早饭时，从电视上听到了那条狗走失的消息。

entries.en: She packed a clean T-shirt beneath her raincoat.
entries.zh: 她把一件干净的T恤放在雨衣下面装好。

entries.meaningZh: 见惯不怪而毫不在意的
entries.en: He seemed blasé about the award after winning so many competitions.
entries.zh: 赢过那么多场比赛后，他对这个奖似乎已见惯不怪，毫不在意。

entries.en: The family keeps a small vegetable garden all the year round.
entries.zh: 这一家人一年到头都种着一小片菜园。

entries.en: Nobody watered the seedlings, and as a consequence they wilted.
entries.zh: 没人给幼苗浇水，因此它们枯萎了。

entries.en: We could sleep in the car as a last resort.
entries.zh: 实在没有别的办法，我们可以睡在车里。

entries.en: Keep your coat nearby because the taxi could arrive at any moment.
entries.zh: 把外套放在身边，因为出租车随时可能到。

entries.en: You can pause the recording at any time and listen again.
entries.zh: 你可以在任何时候暂停录音，重新听一遍。

entries.en: Place the two narrow strips at right angles before tracing their outlines.
entries.zh: 描出轮廓前，先把这两根窄条摆成直角。

entries.en: Were you sitting by yourself when the lights went out?
entries.zh: 停电时，你是独自坐在那里吗？

entries.en: We practised the duet every other day until the concert.
entries.zh: 我们一直每隔一天练习一次二重奏，直到音乐会举行。

entries.en: She held the photograph for a moment before putting it away.
entries.zh: 她拿着照片看了片刻，才把它收起来。

entries.en: The route looked shorter, but on reflection we chose the safer road.
entries.zh: 那条路线看起来较短，但仔细想过之后，我们选了更安全的路。

entries.en: The missing tools included a hammer and a file, among others.
entries.zh: 丢失的工具中包括一把锤子和一把锉刀，此外还有其他工具。

entries.en: Her confidence grew by leaps and bounds after she joined the drama club.
entries.zh: 加入戏剧社后，她的自信心迅速增强。

entries.en: The poem presents its speaker arguing with God about suffering.
entries.zh: 诗中，抒情主人公就苦难的问题与上帝争辩。

entries.en: North is marked by a small arrow on this map.
entries.zh: 这张地图用一个小箭头标出了北方。

entries.en: We hope to finish painting the kitchen before April.
entries.zh: 我们希望在四月之前把厨房粉刷完。

entries.en: Her cousin has invited us to a wedding in June.
entries.zh: 她的堂表亲邀请我们参加六月的一场婚礼。

entries.en: The children spent most of July building a tree house.
entries.zh: 孩子们把七月的大部分时间都用来搭树屋了。

entries.en: I found the receipt inside a diary dated October.
entries.zh: 我在一本标有十月日期的日记本里找到了那张收据。

entries.en: They plan to reopen the little bookshop in September.
entries.zh: 他们计划九月重新开那家小书店。

entries.en: By January, she had filled three notebooks with sketches.
entries.zh: 到一月时，她已画满了三本速写本。

entries.en: Our neighbours brought their dog over on Sunday afternoon.
entries.zh: 邻居星期日下午带着他们的狗过来了。

entries.en: He saved the last packet of seeds to sow in November.
entries.zh: 他把最后一包种子留到十一月再播种。

entries.en: The photograph reminded me of our visit last December.
entries.zh: 那张照片让我想起了我们去年十二月的拜访。

entries.en: She knitted a striped scarf for her father at Christmas.
entries.zh: 圣诞节时，她给父亲织了一条条纹围巾。

entries.en: We spent Saturday morning repairing the garden gate.
entries.zh: 星期六上午，我们一直在修花园的门。

entries.en: The invitation had arrived by the middle of February.
entries.zh: 二月中旬时，邀请函就已经寄到了。

entries.en: The course compares Christian art from several different periods.
entries.zh: 这门课比较了几个不同时期的基督教艺术。

entries.en: Please return the borrowed camera before Friday evening.
entries.zh: 请在星期五晚上之前归还借走的相机。

entries.en: Her first rehearsal is scheduled for Monday after lunch.
entries.zh: 她的第一次排练安排在星期一午饭后。

entries.en: We found the missing parcel outside our door on Wednesday.
entries.zh: 星期三，我们在门外找到了那个丢失的包裹。

entries.en: He offered to cover my shift on Thursday.
entries.zh: 他提出星期四替我值班。

entries.en: The plumber agreed to inspect the leak on Tuesday morning.
entries.zh: 管道工答应星期二上午来检查漏水处。

entries.en: A Pole in our walking group offered to translate the letter.
entries.zh: 我们徒步小组里的一位波兰人提出可以翻译这封信。

entries.en: She borrowed an introductory book on Islam from the library.
entries.zh: 她从图书馆借了一本介绍伊斯兰教的入门书。

entries.en: He found the missing CD inside an old biscuit tin.
entries.zh: 他在一个旧饼干盒里找到了那张丢失的光盘。

entries.en: The painting places Christ near the centre of the crowded scene.
entries.zh: 这幅画把基督安排在拥挤场景的中央附近。

entries.en: Her older sister sent a postcard from China during the trip.
entries.zh: 旅行期间，她姐姐从中国寄来了一张明信片。

entries.en: Her research focuses on Hispanic art from medieval Spain.
entries.zh: 她的研究重点是中世纪西班牙的艺术。

entries.en: The exhibition includes Polish posters from a private collection.
entries.zh: 展览中有一批来自私人收藏的波兰海报。

entries.en: The seminar considered a Marxist interpretation of the novel.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了对这部小说的一种马克思主义解读。

entries.en: We stayed with our maternal grandparents over Easter that year.
entries.zh: 那年复活节期间，我们住在外祖父母家。

entries.meaningZh: 地中海的；地中海沿岸的
entries.en: They rented a small house overlooking a Mediterranean harbour.
entries.zh: 他们租了一座能俯瞰地中海港湾的小房子。

entries.en: Her essay contrasts Marxism with another approach to economic history.
entries.zh: 她的论文把马克思主义与另一种研究经济史的方法作了对比。

entries.en: Excuse me, Mister, you dropped your shopping bag.
entries.zh: 对不起，先生，你的购物袋掉了。

entries.en: She paused beside a Buddhist temple during her walk.
entries.zh: 散步时，她在一座佛寺旁停留了一会儿。

entries.meaningZh: 苏格兰的〔见于传统名称〕
entries.en: She brought a pot of Scotch broth to the village supper.
entries.zh: 她为村里的聚餐带来了一锅苏格兰浓汤。

entries.en: The class discussed Buddhism without expecting everyone to share the same beliefs.
entries.zh: 课堂上讨论了佛教，并不要求每个人都持相同信仰。

entries.en: Utopian plans for the village left little room for disagreement.
entries.zh: 那些乌托邦式的村庄规划几乎不容许不同意见。

entries.en: Maxim after maxim filled his speech, but none answered our question.
entries.zh: 他的发言充斥着一条又一条格言，却没有一条回答我们的问题。

entries.en: Utopia seemed possible to the young idealists in her story.
entries.zh: 在她的故事里，那些年轻的理想主义者觉得乌托邦似乎可以实现。

entries.en: She borrowed a new translation of the Odyssey for the reading group.
entries.zh: 她为读书小组借了一本《奥德赛》的新译本。

entries.meaningZh: 简朴的；缺乏舒适设施的
entries.en: Spartan furnishings made the cabin feel more like a shelter than a holiday home.
entries.zh: 简朴的陈设使那间小屋更像一处庇护所，而非度假住处。

entries.en: She compared the American edition with the copy she had brought from home.
entries.zh: 她把美国版与自己从家里带来的那本作了比较。

entries.en: We changed trains in London before continuing our journey.
entries.zh: 我们在伦敦换乘火车，然后继续旅行。

entries.en: His mother's sister kept a journal during her visit to Britain.
entries.zh: 他姨母访问英国期间一直在写日记。

entries.en: She hopes to spend part of the summer in England.
entries.zh: 她希望夏天抽一段时间去英格兰。

entries.en: The shop sells postcards showing several European cities.
entries.zh: 这家店出售印有几座欧洲城市景色的明信片。

entries.en: They travelled around Europe with a small suitcase each.
entries.zh: 他们每人带着一个小行李箱，在欧洲各地旅行。

entries.en: I kept the train ticket from our journey to Scotland.
entries.zh: 我保留着我们去苏格兰旅行时的火车票。

entries.en: Her older brother returned from France with a suitcase full of books.
entries.zh: 她哥哥从法国回来，带回了满满一箱书。

entries.en: The repaired chair looks OK, but I would test it carefully.
entries.zh: 修好的椅子看起来还不错，不过我会小心地试一试。

entries.en: The museum displayed a Soviet poster beside a handwritten diary.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一张苏联海报与一本手写日记并排展出。

entries.en: He found an old photograph from his trip to Germany.
entries.zh: 他找到了一张自己去德国旅行时拍的旧照片。

entries.en: The novel follows a family preparing to move to America.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一家人准备移居美国的经历。

entries.en: She added a German translation beneath the original paragraph.
entries.zh: 她在原段落下面加上了德语译文。

entries.en: We listened to a Scottish singer at the village hall.
entries.zh: 我们在村会堂听了一位苏格兰歌手演唱。

entries.en: Her photographs of Ireland filled an entire album.
entries.zh: 她在爱尔兰拍的照片装满了整整一本相册。

entries.en: They spent the afternoon walking through Oxford before catching their train.
entries.zh: 赶火车前，他们花了一下午在牛津城里散步。

entries.en: The display included British coins from a donated collection.
entries.zh: 展品中有一批由他人捐赠的英国硬币。

entries.en: The instructor compared AM with FM before discussing the radio receiver.
entries.zh: 老师在讨论无线电接收机前，比较了调幅与调频。

entries.en: The library organised a reading group devoted to African fiction.
entries.zh: 图书馆组织了一个专门阅读非洲小说的读书小组。

entries.en: She wrote a Chinese caption beneath each family photograph.
entries.zh: 她在每张家庭照片下面都写了一条中文说明。

entries.en: The atlas on her desk lay open at the map of Africa.
entries.zh: 她桌上的地图集翻开在非洲地图那一页。

entries.en: He checked the French subtitles before showing us the film.
entries.zh: 给我们放电影前，他检查了法语字幕。

entries.en: The collection includes an Indian textile with a faded floral pattern.
entries.zh: 这批藏品中有一块印度织物，上面的花卉图案已褪色。

entries.en: She hopes to visit Japan after finishing her exams.
entries.zh: 她希望考完试后去日本旅行。

entries.en: They mailed the invitation from Paris before returning home.
entries.zh: 回家之前，他们从巴黎寄出了邀请函。

entries.en: A Russian inscription ran along the edge of the photograph.
entries.zh: 照片边缘写着一行俄语题字。

entries.en: He borrowed a collection of Irish stories for the long journey.
entries.zh: 他为这趟长途旅行借了一本爱尔兰故事集。

entries.en: The instructions included a Japanese translation on the final page.
entries.zh: 说明书最后一页附有日语译文。

entries.en: The novel's narrator remembers a painting of Jesus in her childhood home.
entries.zh: 小说的叙述者回忆起童年家中的一幅耶稣画像。

entries.en: She checked the English version before sending the letter.
entries.zh: 寄信前，她检查了英文版本。

entries.en: The exhibition traced one Jewish family's memories through photographs and letters.
entries.zh: 展览通过照片和书信，回溯了一个犹太家庭的记忆。

entries.en: He carried a sketchbook throughout his holiday in Italy.
entries.zh: 在意大利度假期间，他一直随身带着速写本。

entries.en: Their daughter sent a parcel from Australia containing handmade gifts.
entries.zh: 他们的女儿从澳大利亚寄来了一个装着手工礼物的包裹。

entries.en: She brought back a notebook from her travels in India.
entries.zh: 她从印度旅行回来时带回了一本笔记本。

entries.en: We found the postcard she had sent from Spain.
entries.zh: 我们找到了她从西班牙寄来的那张明信片。

entries.en: His travel diary includes several sketches made in Russia.
entries.zh: 他的旅行日记中有几幅在俄罗斯画的速写。

entries.en: The story follows an Arab who opens a bookshop in an unfamiliar city.
entries.zh: 故事讲述了一个阿拉伯人在一座陌生城市开书店的经历。

entries.en: An Italian cookbook stood between the dictionaries on her shelf.
entries.zh: 她书架上的几本词典之间放着一本意大利烹饪书。

entries.en: The gallery borrowed a Spanish painting for its winter exhibition.
entries.zh: 画廊为冬季展览借来了一幅西班牙画作。

entries.en: The display included a Mexican bowl painted with bright flowers.
entries.zh: 展品中有一只墨西哥碗，上面绘着鲜艳的花朵。

entries.en: The bookshop devoted a whole shelf to Asian literature.
entries.zh: 这家书店把整整一层书架留给了亚洲文学。

entries.en: They met in Cambridge, England, before starting their walking holiday.
entries.zh: 开始徒步度假之前，他们在英国剑桥见了面。

entries.en: She sent the parcel from Birmingham, England, on her way home.
entries.zh: 她回家途中，从英国伯明翰寄出了那个包裹。

entries.en: He copied the Latin inscription into his notebook.
entries.zh: 他把那段拉丁语铭文抄进了笔记本。

entries.en: A Canadian artist donated the landscape painting to the school.
entries.zh: 一位加拿大艺术家把那幅风景画捐给了学校。

entries.en: The children traced their proposed route across Asia on a large map.
entries.zh: 孩子们在一张大地图上描出了他们设想的穿越亚洲的路线。

entries.en: He found the address of a friend living in Moscow.
entries.zh: 他找到了一个住在莫斯科的朋友的地址。

entries.en: The historian compared Olympic pottery with objects from another region of ancient Greece.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家把奥林匹亚的陶器与古希腊另一地区的器物作了比较。

entries.en: She kept the letters her paternal grandparents had sent from Canada.
entries.zh: 她保留着祖父母从加拿大寄来的信。

entries.en: We stayed with a friend in Bristol before continuing by train.
entries.zh: 继续乘火车旅行之前，我们住在布里斯托尔的一位朋友家。

entries.en: They spent their last evening in Berlin sorting through photographs.
entries.zh: 他们在柏林的最后一个晚上都在整理照片。

entries.en: An Australian photographer offered to help us arrange the exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位澳大利亚摄影师提出帮助我们布置展览。

entries.meaningZh: 大西洋的；大西洋沿岸的
entries.en: Their rented cottage overlooked a small Atlantic bay.
entries.zh: 他们租的小屋可以俯瞰大西洋沿岸的一处小海湾。

entries.en: The class compared Roman mosaics with later examples of the same craft.
entries.zh: 课堂上把古罗马马赛克与后世同类工艺的作品作了比较。

entries.en: Her journal described a quiet holiday spent sketching in Greece.
entries.zh: 她的日记记述了一段在希腊画速写的宁静假期。

entries.en: The museum borrowed a Greek vase for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆为展览借来了一只希腊花瓶。

entries.en: He sent us a letter while travelling through Mexico.
entries.zh: 他在墨西哥旅行途中给我们寄来了一封信。

entries.en: The programme ended with a performance by a Cuban singer.
entries.zh: 节目最后是一位古巴歌手的表演。

entries.en: The engineer checked whether the capacitor's value was given in F.
entries.zh: 工程师核查了电容器的数值是否以法拉为单位。

entries.en: Their old photo album included a postcard from Switzerland.
entries.zh: 他们的旧相册里夹着一张来自瑞士的明信片。

entries.en: She saved the ticket from her first visit to Belgium.
entries.zh: 她保留着第一次去比利时时用过的票。

entries.en: An Englishman in our group offered to carry the spare tent.
entries.zh: 我们小组中的一位英格兰男子提出帮忙背备用帐篷。

entries.en: He brought a folded street map back from Tokyo.
entries.zh: 他从东京带回来一张折叠的街道地图。

entries.en: They planned a short stay in Athens before travelling elsewhere in Greece.
entries.zh: 他们计划先在雅典短住，再去希腊其他地方。

entries.en: The exhibition placed Egyptian jewellery beside photographs of the excavation.
entries.zh: 展览把埃及首饰与发掘现场的照片并排陈列。

entries.en: She bought a Swiss watch to celebrate finishing her degree.
entries.zh: 她买了一块瑞士手表，庆祝自己完成学业。

entries.en: A Frenchman standing behind me offered to explain the menu.
entries.zh: 站在我身后的一位法国男子提出可以解释菜单。

entries.en: They kept in touch after her family moved to Malaysia.
entries.zh: 她家搬到马来西亚后，他们仍保持着联系。

entries.en: He checked a Portuguese dictionary before replying to the message.
entries.zh: 回复消息前，他查了一本葡萄牙语词典。

entries.en: She filled a notebook with drawings during her trip to Iceland.
entries.zh: 去冰岛旅行时，她画满了一本笔记本。

entries.en: The class used a model of Venus for the astronomy exhibition.
entries.zh: 班里为天文展览使用了一个金星模型。

entries.en: The invitation included an Arabic greeting beneath the English text.
entries.zh: 邀请函在英文文字下面附了一句阿拉伯语问候。

entries.en: The historical novel follows a Moslem who befriends a travelling painter.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说讲述了一位穆斯林与一名游历各地的画家成为朋友的故事。

entries.en: She sent a postcard from Melbourne, Australia, before returning home.
entries.zh: 回家前，她从澳大利亚墨尔本寄来了一张明信片。

entries.en: The guide compared Byzantine mosaics with paintings from a later period.
entries.zh: 导游把拜占庭马赛克与较晚时期的绘画作了比较。

entries.en: The exhibition explored Arabian architecture through photographs and models.
entries.zh: 展览通过照片和模型介绍了阿拉伯建筑。

entries.en: A Welsh choir rehearsed in the hall while we arranged the chairs.
entries.zh: 我们摆放椅子时，一个威尔士合唱团在礼堂里排练。

entries.en: Her letters from Alaska arrived in a bundle tied with string.
entries.zh: 她从阿拉斯加寄来的信，是用绳子扎成一捆送到的。

entries.en: He drew Jupiter beside the other planets in his notebook.
entries.zh: 他在笔记本上把木星画在其他行星旁边。

entries.en: The children built a model of Antarctica for their geography project.
entries.zh: 孩子们为地理课题制作了一个南极洲模型。

entries.meaningZh: 魔鬼般邪恶的〔文学用语〕
entries.en: Satanic laughter echoed through the villain's castle in the film.
entries.zh: 影片中，魔鬼般邪恶的笑声回荡在反派的城堡里。

entries.en: We found a postcard from Shanghai between the pages of her diary.
entries.zh: 我们在她的日记本里找到了一张来自上海的明信片。

entries.en: His travel album contains several sketches made in Tibet.
entries.zh: 他的旅行相册里收着几幅在西藏画的速写。

entries.en: The class compared Stoic ideas with the arguments in another philosophical text.
entries.zh: 课堂上把斯多葛学派的思想与另一部哲学著作中的论点作了比较。

entries.en: She used a model of Saturn during her classroom presentation.
entries.zh: 课堂展示时，她用了一个土星模型。

entries.en: They mailed the invitation from Ottawa before leaving Canada.
entries.zh: 离开加拿大前，他们从渥太华寄出了邀请函。

entries.en: The museum displayed Mesozoic fossils beside a reconstruction drawing of the ancient landscape.
entries.zh: 博物馆把中生代化石与古代地貌复原图并排展出。

entries.en: Stygian shadows filled the abandoned cellar beyond the reach of her lantern.
entries.zh: 在她的提灯照不到的地方，废弃地窖里满是幽暗阴森的影子。

entries.en: The atlas included a separate map of Oceania.
entries.zh: 这本地图集单独收录了一幅大洋洲地图。

entries.meaningZh: 不顾差异而强求一致的
entries.en: Procrustean rules forced every project into the same format, regardless of its purpose.
entries.zh: 那些强求一致的规则不顾项目的用途，硬把每个项目都塞进同一种格式。

entries.en: Mr Patel left his umbrella beside the reception desk.
entries.zh: 帕特尔先生把伞留在了接待台旁。

entries.en: Mrs Lewis offered to look after our cat during the trip.
entries.zh: 刘易斯太太提出在我们旅行期间帮忙照看猫。

entries.en: The old magazine included an interview with a software designer from MS.
entries.zh: 那本旧杂志刊登了一次对微软公司软件设计师的采访。

entries.en: The story follows a Muslim who opens a bakery with her older sister.
entries.zh: 故事讲述了一位穆斯林与她姐姐一起开面包店的经历。

entries.en: The memoir describes the author's experiences as a Jew in a small town.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录记述了作者作为一位犹太人在小镇生活的经历。

entries.en: The museum displayed Islamic manuscripts beside examples of decorative calligraphy.
entries.zh: 博物馆把伊斯兰教手稿与装饰性书法作品并排展出。

entries.en: The parcel was posted on 12 Jan and arrived several days later.
entries.zh: 包裹于一月十二日寄出，几天后送达。

entries.en: He moved the family photographs from his old PC to a portable hard drive.
entries.zh: 他把家庭照片从旧个人电脑转存到了一块移动硬盘上。

entries.en: The museum used a Victorian kitchen to illustrate daily domestic routines.
entries.zh: 博物馆借助一间维多利亚女王时代的厨房，展示日常家务活动。

entries.en: The library hosted a discussion about Christianity and its place in the novel.
entries.zh: 图书馆举办了一场讨论，探讨基督教及其在这部小说中的地位。

entries.en: She phoned her GP to arrange an appointment for the following week.
entries.zh: 她打电话给自己的全科医生，预约下周就诊。

entries.en: Her poem addresses the Creator in a tone of doubt rather than certainty.
entries.zh: 她的诗以怀疑而非确信的语气向造物主倾诉。

entries.en: The archive contained letters from several Protestant congregations.
entries.zh: 档案中收有来自几个新教教会团体的信件。

entries.en: The students compared two older reports published by the IMF.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了国际货币基金组织发表的两份较早的报告。

entries.en: They walked along Whitehall before stopping for lunch.
entries.zh: 他们沿着白厅走了一段路，然后停下来吃午饭。

entries.en: The review distinguished GDP from GTP in its discussion of nucleotide binding.
entries.zh: 综述在讨论核苷酸结合时，区分了鸟苷二磷酸与鸟苷三磷酸。

entries.meaningZh: 乔治王时代的〔英国历史〕
entries.en: The exhibition compared Georgian furniture with pieces from a later period.
entries.zh: 展览把乔治王时代的家具与较晚时期的家具作了比较。

entries.en: A Briton in our group offered to share her travel guide.
entries.zh: 我们小组中的一位英国人提出可以与大家共用她的旅行指南。

entries.en: She found her favourite LP at the bottom of the box.
entries.zh: 她在箱子底下找到了自己最喜欢的那张密纹唱片。

entries.en: The analyst compared GNP figures for the two preceding years.
entries.zh: 分析师比较了前两年的国民生产总值数据。

entries.en: The invitation gave the meeting time in GMT to avoid confusion.
entries.zh: 邀请函用格林威治平均时注明会议时间，以免混淆。

entries.en: The novel follows a Hindu who returns to her childhood village.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一位印度教徒回到童年村庄的经历。

entries.en: The theatre hired someone to handle PR for the new production.
entries.zh: 剧院聘请了一人，负责新剧目的公关工作。

entries.en: The fictional detective suspects that the missing visitor once worked for the CIA.
entries.zh: 小说中的侦探怀疑，那位失踪的访客曾为美国中央情报局工作。

entries.en: Her sketchbook contains a drawing of the Vatican.
entries.zh: 她的速写本里有一幅梵蒂冈的画。

entries.meaningZh: 石油输出国组织；欧佩克
entries.en: The seminar used older articles about OPEC as background reading.
entries.zh: 研讨课把几篇有关欧佩克的旧文章作为背景阅读材料。

entries.en: In the novel, the missing letter attracts the attention of the FBI.
entries.zh: 在这部小说中，那封失踪的信引起了美国联邦调查局的注意。

entries.en: The documentary crew arranged an interview with ABC in Australia.
entries.zh: 纪录片摄制组与澳大利亚广播公司安排了一次采访。

entries.en: The receiver switched from AM to FM when we adjusted the dial.
entries.zh: 我们调节旋钮时，接收机从调幅切换到了调频。

entries.en: The artist drew the Kremlin from a photograph in her collection.
entries.zh: 艺术家照着自己收藏的一张照片画了克里姆林宫。

entries.en: She borrowed a book about NASA from the school library.
entries.zh: 她从学校图书馆借了一本介绍美国国家航空航天局的书。

entries.meaningZh: 千兆字节〔存储容量单位〕
entries.en: The backup was several GB larger than the empty drive could hold.
entries.zh: 备份文件比那块空硬盘的容量还大几GB。

entries.en: The diagram showed a circuit powered by DC rather than AC.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了一个使用直流电而非交流电供电的电路。

entries.en: The old instrument could measure AC as well as DC.
entries.zh: 这台旧仪器既能测量交流电，也能测量直流电。

entries.en: The researchers compared the pH of water samples from three ponds.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了三个池塘水样的氢离子指数。

entries.en: A Latino in our writing group shared a story about his childhood.
entries.zh: 我们写作小组中的一位拉丁美洲人分享了一个童年故事。

entries.en: The children made paper lanterns for Halloween.
entries.zh: 孩子们为万圣节前夕制作了纸灯笼。

entries.en: The curator hung a Madonna beside two landscape paintings.
entries.zh: 策展人把一幅圣母像挂在两幅风景画旁边。

entries.en: The course examined Catholicism through letters, paintings, and personal diaries.
entries.zh: 这门课通过书信、绘画和私人日记探讨天主教信仰。

entries.en: The report warned against judging a student's future by IQ alone.
entries.zh: 报告提醒，不要仅凭智商判断一个学生的未来。

entries.en: She borrowed an introductory book about Judaism for the discussion group.
entries.zh: 她为讨论小组借了一本介绍犹太教的入门书。

entries.meaningZh: 心灵交流；情感交融〔正式用语〕
entries.en: Communion with nature brought her a quiet sense of belonging.
entries.zh: 与大自然的心灵交流，让她有一种宁静的归属感。

entries.en: The officer returned to HQ after inspecting the camp.
entries.zh: 检查营地后，那位军官返回了指挥部。

entries.en: She completed her BA before training as a librarian.
entries.zh: 她先获得文学士学位，然后接受图书馆员培训。

entries.en: The guide pointed out a Hebrew inscription above the doorway.
entries.zh: 导游指出了门上方的一段希伯来语铭文。

entries.en: The damaged LCD made the camera difficult to use.
entries.zh: 液晶显示器受损，使这台相机很难使用。

entries.en: They spent a rainy afternoon exploring Cologne on foot.
entries.zh: 他们在一个下雨的下午徒步游览了科隆。

entries.en: The memoir follows a Mormon who moves to a new town.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录讲述了一位摩门教徒搬到一座新镇的经历。

entries.en: The play presents Satan as a character struggling to persuade the hero.
entries.zh: 这部戏把撒旦塑造成一个竭力说服主人公的角色。

entries.en: The novel follows a Saxon who befriends a travelling merchant.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位撒克逊人与一名游历各地的商人成为朋友的故事。
